title: Backspace String Compare
statement:
Given two strings S and T containing lowercase letters and `#` characters, return `YES` if they are equal when both are typed into empty text editors. `#` means a backspace character (deletes the preceding character, if any).

If they are not equal, return `NO`.
inputFormat:
Line 1: string S.
Line 2: string T.
constraints:
1 <= |S|, |T| <= 10^5
S and T only contain lowercase letters and '#'.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
t = input().strip()
